arStrings.szText: A strange notice left by one of the Mother's Faithful.

The notice left in Sarpeda bore the mark of "one of the Mother's Faithful." Lilith's worshippers are bold to leave such signs in the open. 

It bids me to find an old house in Celestia's abandoned capital, one marked with a red knot. I should tread carefully.

Respond to the Voice through the Reinforced Door

The red knot dangled from a half-rotted beam, marking the house as promised. When I approached, a voice behind the locked door asked for a password. I swear I know that voice...but now's not the time to dwell on it.

I've no time for coy riddles. I'll enter the Abandoned House and learn who waits within.

In Sarpeda, a local fisherman told me a foreigner has been looking for the famed Wanderer. Whoever she is, she pinned a message to the nearby notice board. I should take a look.
